{{Quote|I know you don’t want to hear this. Despite our losses, you did something important down there.|Garik Loran to Voort saBinring about the mission|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mission to Chashima''' took place in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chashima]]. Members of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] group [[Wraith Squadron]]&mdash;[[Estoric Sandskimmer]], [[Hohass Ekwesh]] and, [[Voort saBinring]]&mdash;infiltrated the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Shaper caste|shapers']] compound to steal a new bioweapon developed by the Vong, which the invaders planned to use against the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="MK" /> 

The infiltration was successful, and Sandskimmer and Ekwesh escaped the compound with the weapon called a [[Commbuzzer]], but they were soon chased down by Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]], forcing them to fight. During the confrontation, Sandskimmer was impaled through the [[Heart/Legends|heart]] by one of the warriors' [[amphistaff]]s and [[Death/Legends|died]]. Ekwesh also died during the battle after being poisoned an amphistaff and having to be mercy-killed by saBingring by shooting him in the head with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="MK" />
